title: Redbud Line Services: 2027 recordable injuries on Pinewater work
task_type: discrete choice and limited dependent variable modeling
decision: how many recordable injuries Redbud's field employees will record on Pinewater work in 2027, and whether the rate they make on the 2027 work plan stays within CS-4's limit of 3.0
